<!-- Source page: K3s -->

[K3s](https://k3s.io/) is a simplified <a href="Kubernetes" class="wikilink" title="Kubernetes">Kubernetes</a> version that bundles Kubernetes cluster components into a few small binaries optimized for Edge and IoT devices.

NixOS's K3s documentation is available at:

<https://github.com/NixOS/nixpkgs/blob/master/pkgs/applications/networking/cluster/k3s/README.md>
